pain_point: Worried about Truganina infrastructure - Is the infrastructure keeping up with development out there? Roads parking services?
primary_text: "Is the infrastructure keeping up with development out there? Roads, parking, services?" Don't take our word for it — look at who's already there. Major freight companies, distribution centres, and established small businesses are operating across Truganina's industrial estates daily. They didn't move here on a hunch. The roads are built. The services are connected. The freight routes work. These new off-the-plan warehouses sit within a properly serviced estate with truck-friendly access, sealed parking, and connections to the Princes Freeway and Western Ring Road. We'll arrange a site visit so you can see the infrastructure for yourself and talk to businesses already operating here.
description: Major freight and distribution companies already operate in the precinct
